name: Pulumi
tagline: Infrastructure as code using real programming languages.
shortDescription: Pulumi provides CLI previews, SDKs, Automation API, ESC, and Pulumi Cloud REST API.
agentSummary: Agents can propose infrastructure as code, run previews, and call Pulumi Cloud APIs with JSON output.
bestFor: Programmable IaC, previewed infra changes, multi-cloud provisioning, and automation APIs.
cautionNotes: Key limitations: Apply/update operations can change production infrastructure; require review and scoped stack tokens. Deploys, secret changes, IAM, billing, networking, deletes, and rollback paths have high production blast radius; require scoped credentials and review gates. CLI access is powerful but can run destructive local or production commands; prefer dry runs, preview environments, and non-production credentials. API automation needs client-side throttling, idempotency where supported, pagination limits, retries, and audit logging.
pricingSummary: Open-source CLI plus public Pulumi Cloud pricing.
authModel: Pulumi access tokens, cloud provider credentials, ESC environments, and stack permissions.
accountCreation: CLI can run locally; Pulumi Cloud self-serve signup.
browserSupport: Pulumi Cloud UI supports stacks, previews, resources, and audit review.

capabilities.detail: CLI supports preview, up, destroy, stack, config, and JSON output.
pulumi api can call Pulumi Cloud REST endpoints non-interactively.
